title: MyHardcore
description: A lightweight hardcore companion mod with a custom HUD, themes, statistics, milestones, day celebrations, and persistent progress.
body:
# MyHardcore

MyHardcore is a lightweight hardcore companion mod designed to make long-term survival worlds easier to track without changing vanilla gameplay.

The mod adds a clean custom HUD, a `/myhardcore` menu, survival statistics, configurable HUD themes, milestone tracking, day celebrations, and persistent progress saving.

## Features

- Custom hardcore HUD with survival statistics
- Four HUD themes: Red, Blue, Green, and Purple
- Persistent settings, statistics, milestones, and progress
- In-game `/myhardcore` menu
- Toggleable scoreboard lines
- Statistics menu for tracking long-term survival progress
- Milestones menu with completion status and completed day display
- Day celebration messages for major survival milestones
- Optional milestone completion sounds
- Clean GUI item tooltips without vanilla weapon or tool attribute clutter

## Tracked statistics

MyHardcore can track:

- Survived days
- Playtime
- Walked distance
- Total XP levels
- Mob kills
- Mined blocks
- Placed blocks
- Totem pops
- Milestone progress

## Milestones

The mod currently includes these milestones:

- First Diamond
- Enter The Nether
- Wither Defeated
- Enter The End
- Dragon Slayer
- Elytra Obtained
- Survive 100 Days
- Full Netherite Armor
- All Advancements

## Notes

MyHardcore is intended as a lightweight helper for hardcore worlds. It does not add new items, blocks, dimensions, mobs, or progression systems. It is focused on tracking, displaying, and saving useful hardcore survival progress.
